summary: This chunk adds a debug-loop eval fixture: a buggy slugify function (slug.py) with a typo calling .stip() instead of .strip(), three pytest tests exercising it (test_slug.py), and a new reference doc tactics.md covering deeper debug tactics: git bisect for regressions, building a check when none exists, automating gates with hooks, delegating investigation to subagents, catching fixes that overfit tests, and context hygiene during long sessions.

claims.text: slugify calls text.lower().stip() where .stip() is not a valid str method (should be .strip())
Three tests are defined: test_basic, test_trims_whitespace, test_collapses_punctuation
Binary search via git bisect finds a culprit commit in about 10 steps across 1,000 commits
claims.anchor: references/tactics.md: Locating a regression with git bisect

claims.text: A Stop hook can block the turn from ending until a check passes, but Claude Code overrides it after 8 consecutive blocks
claims.anchor: references/tactics.md: Automating the gate with hooks

claims.text: A subagent run costs about three times the tokens of the same work inline
Compacting should happen at about 60% context use, ahead of the automatic threshold
claims.anchor: references/tactics.md: Context hygiene during a long session
